name: tests-wall
cmd: set -o pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun test core/runtime-keys.test.ts core/count-cubes.test.ts core/compile.test.ts core/exists-support.test.ts core/small-laws.test.ts core/sample-cache.test.ts core/cube-rows.test.ts core/quorum-laws.test.ts core/counts-preflight.test.ts core/exists.test.ts core/count-write-frames.test.ts research/track-gen/t14-stutter.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -12

name: gen-paired
cmd: set -o pipefail; grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo; mkdir -p base && tar -xf baselines/base.tar -C base && (cp -R vendor/. base/vendor/ 2>/dev/null || true) && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && (cd base && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null) && for r in 1 2 3; do for side in mine base; do d=.; [ $side = base ] && d=base; echo "PAIR $r $side"; (cd $d && GDP_COUNTS_TRACE=1 timeout -s KILL 120 bun research/track-gen/t13-generation.ts mldr 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -v T13_DATA | grep '"phases"\|finite Houdini' | cut -c1-260); done; done

name: prof-generation
cmd: set -o pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && mkdir -p prof && GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 120 bun --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-md --cpu-prof-dir=prof --cpu-prof-interval=2000 research/track-gen/t13-generation.ts mldr > gen.out 2> gen.err; echo EXIT $?; grep -v 'T13_DATA' gen.err | grep '\[infer join small instance\|\[infer join pool\|"phases"' | cut -c1-300; echo PROFILE; f=$(ls prof/*.md | head -1); sed -n 1,50p "$f"
